name: Ghost Fall
source:
There is a waterfall called the "Ghost Fall" in Shimane Prefecture. There is a small shrine near the waterfall, which has a small, wooden offering box. This is a story about the legend of that waterfall.

A short variation of the Legend of the Yurei-Daki from Kudo Masahiro.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=30520]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
岛根县有一座名为“幽灵瀑布”的瀑布。瀑布附近有一座小神社，神社里放着小小的木制赛钱箱。这是一个关于那座瀑布传说的故事。

工藤正广《幽灵瀑布传说》的短篇改编。

[来自[url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=30520]Lemma Soft论坛[/url]]
